rows.section: Tax inventory: company, self-employed, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (foreign residents)
rows.value: 30% up to $135,000, 37% to $190,000, 45% above; no tax-free threshold and no Medicare levy; withheld under Scale 3
rows.note: Federal; paid by: Foreign-resident employees; legal basis: Income Tax Rates Act 1986 Sch 7 Part II; ITAA 1936 s 6(1) and s 251U; details: non-resident
rows.source_title: Income Tax Assessment Act 1936 (compilation of 1 October 2026), section 6(1) (definition of resident) and section 251U(1)(d)

rows.section: Tax inventory: company, self-employed, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Self-employed contributions
rows.value: None compulsory: no social security contributions; super for yourself is voluntary (deductible within the concessional cap)
rows.note: Federal; paid by: Sole traders and partners; legal basis: Superannuation Guarantee (Administration) Act 1992 ss 12, 16A; ITAA 1997 s 290-150; details: self-employed
rows.source_title: Superannuation Guarantee (Administration) Act 1992 (compilation of 1 July 2026), sections 12 and 16A; Income Tax Assessment Act 1997 section 290-150

rows.section: Tax inventory: company, self-employed, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Contractor rules: no-ABN withholding, voluntary agreements, labour hire, super for contractors
rows.value: 47% withheld if no ABN is quoted; 20% (or the payee's instalment rate) under a voluntary agreement; super guarantee for contracts mainly for labour
rows.note: Federal; paid by: Businesses paying contractors; legal basis: TAA 1953 Sch 1 ss 12-55, 12-60, 12-190; TA Regulations 2017 ss 38, 70; SG(A) Act s 12(3); Fair Work Act s 15AA; ITAA 1997 Divs 84-87; details: contractor-rules
rows.source_title: Taxation Administration Regulations 2017 (compilation of 27 August 2026), section 38 and the definition of 'top rate' in section 5; Taxation Administration Act 1953 Schedule 1 sections 12-190 and 15-10

rows.section: Tax inventory: company, self-employed, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Company tax (corporate income tax) and the multinational minimum tax
rows.value: 30%, or 25% for a base rate entity (aggregated turnover under $50 million, no more than 80% passive income); 15% minimum tax for groups with revenue of 750 million euros or more
rows.note: Federal; paid by: Companies; legal basis: Income Tax Rates Act 1986 ss 23-23AB; Taxation (Multinational—Global and Domestic Minimum Tax) Act 2024; details: company-tax-minimum
rows.source_title: Taxation (Multinational—Global and Domestic Minimum Tax) Act 2024 (No. 132, 2024; latest version, as made 10 December 2024), sections 5, 6, 8, 10 and 12

rows.section: Tax inventory: company, self-employed, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Simplified regime for small businesses: none; small business concessions apply
rows.value: No presumptive or flat-rate regime; concessions for small business entities (turnover under $10 million), assets under $20,000 written off at once, small business income tax offset
rows.note: Federal; paid by: Sole traders and small businesses; legal basis: ITAA 1997 Divisions 328 (Subdivisions 328-C, 328-D, 328-F); details: small-business
rows.source_title: Income Tax Assessment Act 1997 (compilation of 1 October 2026), sections 328-110 and 328-180

rows.section: Tax inventory: company, self-employed, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Branch profits tax: no separate tax; branch profits are taxed at the company rates
rows.value: Company tax at 30% (or 25%) on the branch's Australian taxable income; no separate remittance tax in the Acts read
rows.note: Federal; paid by: Foreign companies with an Australian branch; legal basis: Income Tax Rates Act 1986 s 23; ITAA 1997 ss 4-1, 6-5(3); details: branch-profits-tax
rows.source_title: Income Tax Rates Act 1986 (compilation of 1 July 2026), section 23 and Schedule 7; Income Tax Assessment Act 1997 sections 4-1 and 6-5(3)

rows.section: Tax inventory: company, self-employed, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Land tax (state and territory)
rows.value: Each state sets its own thresholds and scales (top marginal rates 1.26% to 2.67%); foreign-owner surcharges of 0.75% to 5% in five states and territories; none in the Northern Territory
rows.note: State and territory; paid by: Owners of taxable land (not the home they live in); legal basis: Each state's land tax Act; details: land-tax-nsw
rows.source_title: Revenue NSW: Land tax thresholds and rates (last updated 16 March 2026); and the other state pages in the land-tax sections

rows.section: Tax inventory: company, self-employed, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Property transfer duty (stamp duty), state and territory
rows.value: Each state sets its own sliding scale (top rates 4.5% to 7%); first-home buyer exemptions or concessions; foreign purchaser surcharges of 7% to 9% in six states
rows.note: State and territory; paid by: Buyers of land and buildings; legal basis: Each state's duties Act; details: stamp-duty-nsw
rows.source_title: Revenue NSW: How to calculate transfer duty (last updated 6 October 2026); and the other state pages in the stamp-duty sections
